hypotheses.D0_feature_coverage: At least 25 predeclared labels pass the already-locked model competence gate.
hypotheses.D1_late_semantic_dictionary: Leave-one-out response-direction prototype accuracy is at least 0.25 at Blocks 12 and 17.
hypotheses.D2_semantics_beat_random_objectives: At Blocks 12 and 17, semantic response-direction accuracy is at least twice the matched vocabulary-permuted objective accuracy.
hypotheses.D3_semantic_recurrence_beats_random: At Blocks 12 and 17, the semantic same/different response-similarity ratio is at least 1.25 times the matched random-objective ratio.
hypotheses.D4_late_directions_are_cleaner: Semantic response prototype accuracy at Block 17 exceeds accuracy at Block 1 by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.D5_input_conditioning_remains: Semantic incoming-adjoint prototype accuracy exceeds response-direction accuracy by at least 0.10 at one of Blocks 8, 12, or 17.
